Appearance: Clear Liquid/ Clear Pale Yellow Liquid 2. Odor: Characteristic 3. Density ( at 20°C) (Bulk Weight): 1.22 g/ml 4. Boiling point: > 200°C 5. Decomposition Temperature: > 200°C 6. 3. Suitability is subject to actual plant trial. 4. Shelf life of the material should be minimum 02 years. Note: (a) In support of above, the bidder should produce copies of purchase orders, experience certificates, job c ompletion certificates of customer as a documentary evidence. (b) Bidder to furnish stipulated documents support of fulfillment of qualifying criteria. Non submission or in complete submission of documents may lead to rejection of offer. (c) For MSE & Start-up firm (registered for the tendered items) ‘Experience & Past Performance’ shall be ex empted. However, its capacity & capability may be verified (if necessary) by the Currency Note Press, Nas hik. III) UNDERTAKING: a) The bidder should give undertaking/declaration on the letter head of the firm that they have read and u nderstood all the terms & conditions of tender documents including GIT and GCC and submitting unconditi onal acceptance to all terms & conditions. b) The bidder should give a duly signed and stamped undertaking of declaration that they have not been bl acklisted/ debarred for dealing by any Government department in India. c) Documentary evidence/ Undertaking against Make in India status i.e. being a Class I/ Class II supplier wit h details of local content on firm’s letterhead. d) Undertaking toward compliance of border sharing criteria as per guidelines issued by Government of In dia (vide letter no. F. No. 6/18/2019-PPD dated 23rd/24th July 2020 or any further amendments thereof). IV) The bidder shall enclose copy of GST Registration & PAN details. VII) Payment Terms: Payments will be made after acceptance of Goods and production of all required d ocuments certified by competent authority for Currency Note Press, Nashik Road on pro-rata basis for each installment. VIII) Evaluation Method: The total price quoted for all items shall be considered for evaluation after RA t o decide L-1 bidder. IX) Warranty: Warranty period is 3 months from the date of supply and acceptance of material at Currenc y Note Press, Nashik Road. X) Performance Security Deposit : 5% of order value. Note : Before issue of order on GeM on successful firm " Notification of Award of Contract" will be issued o n firm duly requesting to deposit the performance security within 15 days (as per GeM).
